en.title: Plot targeting Manchester's Jewish community disrupted, say police
en.summary: Police arrested two men in connection with a suspected terrorist plot aimed at the Jewish community in Manchester.

stories.title: Earl Spencer apologises to Piers Morgan over factual error in Diana book

en.title: Earl Spencer apologises to Piers Morgan over factual error in Diana book
en.summary: Earl Spencer has apologised to Piers Morgan for an inaccuracy in his Diana memoir, with the publisher planning to correct the error in future editions.

stories.title: Earl Spencer apologises to Piers Morgan over ‘incorrect assumption’

en.title: Earl Spencer apologises to Piers Morgan over 'incorrect assumption'
en.summary: Earl Spencer apologised to Piers Morgan for incorrectly stating in his Diana book that Morgan was responsible for publishing intrusive photos of the late princess in the 1990s, following Morgan's threat to sue.

stories.title: Father admits causing death of his son in hotel fall

en.title: Father admits causing death of his son in hotel fall
en.summary: A father admitted responsibility for the death of his two-year-old son, who fell from a hotel window in Cyprus in July, during court proceedings in Paphos.

stories.title: Trump defends actions in Iran and Venezuela in UN General Assembly address amid rising tensions with allies – live

en.title: Trump defends actions in Iran and Venezuela in UN General Assembly address amid rising tensions with allies – live
en.summary: Trump made strong statements about Iran during his UN address, threatening military action while also addressing US policy positions on Cuba, Mexico, Greenland and artificial intelligence. He also called on Russia to settle its war.

stories.title: Earl Spencer book latest: Piers Morgan receives apology for ‘error’ in bombshell Diana memoir as he pursues legal action

en.title: Earl Spencer book latest: Piers Morgan receives apology for 'error' in bombshell Diana memoir as he pursues legal action
en.summary: Earl Spencer has apologized to Piers Morgan for an error in his Princess Diana memoir regarding claims about Morgan being uninvited from the funeral. Morgan is continuing legal action against the earl.

stories.title: Briton pleads guilty to ‘recklessly’ causing death of his son in Cyprus

en.title: Briton pleads guilty to 'recklessly' causing death of his son in Cyprus
en.summary: A British man pleaded guilty to recklessly causing his toddler's death after the child fell from a fourth-floor hotel window in Cyprus in July. He accepted the charge to avoid a prolonged trial.

stories.title: Piers Morgan vows to sue Earl Spencer despite receiving an apology

en.title: Piers Morgan vows to sue Earl Spencer despite receiving an apology
en.summary: Piers Morgan has stated his intention to proceed with legal action against Earl Spencer despite receiving an apology regarding the Diana memoir dispute.

stories.title: British father admits causing toddler son’s death after fall from Cyprus hotel

en.title: British father admits causing toddler son's death after fall from Cyprus hotel
en.summary: A British father admitted responsibility for his young son's death after the child fell through an open window at a Cyprus hotel while in his care. His legal team characterizes the incident as a tragic accident.

stories.title: Former Radio 1 DJ Tim Westwood charged with two more offences

en.title: Former Radio 1 DJ Tim Westwood charged with two more offences
en.summary: Former Radio 1 DJ Tim Westwood, aged 68, has been charged with indecent assault of a teenage girl in 1991 and sexual assault of a young woman in 2004. He is scheduled to appear in court at a date to be determined.

stories.title: Tim Westwood charged with two more sexual offences

en.title: Tim Westwood charged with two more sexual offences
en.summary: Former Radio 1 DJ Tim Westwood faces charges related to alleged sexual offences from 1991 and 2004.

en.summary: A British father has entered a guilty plea regarding his young son's death following a fall from a hotel window in Cyprus.

en.summary: The European Union is removing Mikhail Fridman and Alisher Usmanov from its sanctions list as part of an agreement to extend broader curbs on Russia for an additional three years.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia signals East-West pipeline reopening

en.title: Saudi Arabia signals East-West pipeline reopening
en.summary: Saudi Arabia indicates it will reopen a major pipeline route connecting its crude oil production to the Red Sea, which has been shut for two weeks following drone attacks.

en.title: Trump threatens to 'annihilate' Iran even as he predicts post-election peace deal
en.summary: The US president made military threats against Iran while simultaneously claiming his administration would achieve peace following the election, during a United Nations address highlighting his foreign and domestic record.

stories.title: AI staff complain of mental toll over fears of threat to society

en.title: AI staff complain of mental toll over fears of threat to society
en.summary: Researchers at major artificial intelligence companies including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and Aisi report experiencing burnout and stress related to concerns about the societal risks of developing advanced AI systems.

en.title: 'MBS will not forget': Trump's reluctance to fight Houthis rattles Saudi Arabia
en.summary: US hesitation to confront Houthi forces has raised concerns in Saudi Arabia about America's dependability as a defence partner, according to officials in Riyadh.
